title: GIG-3741: Output An Auth-Bypass App Link From Cortex Review
description: After ngramx review refreshes a ticket environment, it prints a single-use local magic link that signs the reviewer into the running app.

test_plan.description: Review prints a clickable login link for an identity app
steps: From earl-kendrick-core, run php bin/ngramx from this branch: review gig-3561 --worktree
Confirm the output includes an Auth bypass URL on the worktree host
Open that URL once and confirm you are signed in as hello@gigabyte.software without an email code
Open the same URL again and confirm it is rejected

test_plan.description: The same link is printed for Think Fire Defence
steps: From think-fire-defence, run review gig-2501 --worktree with this branch's ngramx
If the first run fails while the container entrypoint is still installing, run it again once the app is up
Open the Auth bypass URL and confirm you are signed in as hello@gigabyte.software

test_plan.description: Shared hosted databases and non-identity apps do not get a login link
steps: Run review with --anon and confirm it skips minting a link
Run review in a project that does not use gigabyte/laravel-identity and confirm no Auth bypass line is printed
